# Stable Video Diffusion XT (25 frames)

Stability AI · released 2023-11

Image-to-video model requiring a starting image; not text-to-video. Original release, distinct from SVD XT 1.1. Place a starting image at input.png. CUDA GPU plus system RAM required for CPU offload. 8GB VRAM is a planning estimate based on the documented chunking/offload setup; not a local measurement.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt/blob/9e43909513c6714f1bc78bcb44d96e733cd242aa/README.md)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

### Run it on your own machine

**Other engines**

```sh
# fp16 · CPU offload · ~8GB
uv run --with torch --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with imageio-ffmpeg python -c "import torch; from diffusers import StableVideoDiffusionPipeline; from diffusers.utils import load_image, export_to_video; p=StableVideoDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt', torch_dtype=torch.float16, variant='fp16'); p.enable_model_cpu_offload(); p.unet.enable_forward_chunking(); image=load_image('input.png').resize((1024,576)); frames=p(image, num_frames=25, decode_chunk_size=2).frames[0]; export_to_video(frames, 'video.mp4', fps=7)"
```
